shortDescription: GRAND CAYMAN, Cayman Islands, Sept. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oxbridge Re Holdings Limited (Nasdaq: OXBR) ("Oxbridge" or the "Company") today announced that members of its executive team will attend the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, taking place September 14-16, 2026…

children: ) ("Oxbridge" or the "Company") today announced that members of its executive team will attend the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, taking place September 14-16, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel in New York City.
The conference brings together public companies, institutional investors, family offices and other capital markets participants for one-on-one meetings, presentations and networking.

Oxbridge will attend to engage with existing and prospective investors and discuss the Company's evolution as a multi-platform company spanning AI infrastructure, tokenized real-world assets and reinsurance. Through AI GridWorks, Oxbridge is expanding into AI infrastructure and data center development, while SurancePlus continues to advance the Company's RWA tokenization platform alongside its established reinsurance business.
In addition, the team will also be holding investor meetings in New York outside of the conference.
Investors interested in meeting with Oxbridge are encouraged to reach out directly to our Chairman and CEO, Jay Madhu, using the contact details below.

Oxbridge Re Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: OXBR, OXBRW) ("Oxbridge") is a publicly traded holding company headquartered in the Cayman Islands, focused on building and growing businesses at the intersection of digital finance and artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Through its SurancePlus platform, Oxbridge has pioneered the tokenization of Real-World Assets (RWAs) by developing one of the first blockchain-based platforms to offer tokenized reinsurance securities sponsored by a subsidiary of a publicly traded company. The Company's regulated reinsurance subsidiaries, Oxbridge Reinsurance Limited and Oxbridge Re NS, provide property and casualty reinsurance solutions serving insurers in the Gulf Coast region of the United States.

Through AI GridWorks, Oxbridge is expanding into AI infrastructure with a focus on developing, owning, and operating AI data centers and the supporting infrastructure required to meet the rapidly growing demand for AI compute.
For more information, visit www.oxbridgere.com, www.suranceplus.com, and www.aigridworks.ai

title: Oxbridge to Attend H.C. Wainwright’s 28th Annual Global Investment Conference in New York
